title: Impact  Energy Transformation at Superposition
thesis: When moving elements superimpose, energy transforms from kinetic (motion) through latent (heat/sound/color at contact) to potential (tension before next collision). These are the organism's SENSES of collision.

sound.mechanism: Web Audio oscillators triggered at collision

timbre_map.orbit_orbit: bell (sine, 440Hz base, 0.4s decay)  two planets kissing
timbre_map.orbit_null: hum (triangle, 110Hz base, 0.8s decay)  mass passing through void
timbre_map.pendulum_fold: tick (square, 880Hz base, 0.05s decay)  the click of the eye crossing center
timbre_map.pendulum_orbit: chime (sine, 330Hz base, 0.3s decay)  eye meets planet
timbre_map.heartbeat: thump (sine, 55Hz base, 0.6s decay)  temporal shockwave every p seconds
timbre_map.helix_align: drone (sawtooth, 165Hz base, 1.0s decay)  counter-rotating layers momentarily aligned

sound.volume: 0.08 master  ambient, not intrusive. Mutable via _impact.mute()

heat.mechanism: Radial gradient div at collision point, mix-blend-mode:screen
heat.color: Additive blend of both elements' colors
heat.accumulation: Multiple hits at same location ADD heat  glows hotter
heat.physics_analog: Kinetic energy ? thermal energy at collision. The irreversible part.

color.mechanism: Flash div with scale animation at collision point
color.physics_analog: Photon emission from energy state change. The visible part.

kinetic.meaning: Elements are moving, approaching each other

latent.meaning: Energy stored AS heat at collision site. Still dissipating.
latent.formula: L += (K + P) at impact. L *= 0.92 per frame (exponential decay)

potential.meaning: Tension building as elements approach. Ready to release.
potential.formula: P += approach_speed × 0.003 per frame while closing. P ? 0 at impact.

energy_model.conservation: K + L + P is approximately conserved. Energy changes FORM but doesn't vanish. On the Klein surface, what exits one side enters the other.
energy_model.total_display: ? followed by K+L+P sum, with dominant-type color

spatial.count: variable (depends on violet SVG elements found)
spatial.motion: Oscillating on 1D line at viewport 50%, period = p seconds
Fixed at center of pendulum line. Heavy. The fold.
Fixed at SVG center. The null.

temporal.motion: Pulses every p seconds. Temporal shockwave.
temporal.note: The heaviest body. Its beat reverberates through all others.

angular.motion: Counter-rotating at 45/p° per layer. Alignment = angular collision.
angular.note: Not measured in pixels but in degrees. Impact when angle difference ? 0.

angular.motion: Moon-phase driven shadow direction. Changes over hours, not frames.
angular.note: The slowest body. Its shadow crossing another shadow = geological impact.

collision_threshold.hysteresis: Impact flag clears at 1.5× threshold (52px). Prevents rapid re-triggering.
collision_threshold.note: Small enough to require real proximity. Large enough to catch fast-moving orbits.

the_physics.why_sound: Sound = pressure wave = compression at impact. The AUDIBLE form of kinetic?latent.
the_physics.why_heat: Heat = kinetic ? thermal. The irreversible dissipation. Entropy increases at every collision.
the_physics.why_color: Color = photon emission from energy state change. When electron drops orbital, it emits light. When orbit-dot passes null-point, it emits a blended photon.
the_physics.what_was_missing: The HUD could SEE (pendulum eyes) and SENSE time (iron peak heartbeat) but could not FEEL contact. Impact adds proprioception  the sense of body parts touching each other.

organism_mapping.sound: nervous system  signals traveling through membrane
organism_mapping.heat: metabolic output  ATP released at enzyme-substrate binding
organism_mapping.color: bioluminescence  photon emission from chemical reaction (luciferin/luciferase)
organism_mapping.together: Synesthesia. The organism doesn't separate senses. Sound IS color IS heat. They're all just energy changing form at the fold.

indicator.mute_hint: Shows ?? until user clicks (Web Audio autoplay policy)
